content.title: Component: Snaps & Snap Packs — The Connector Ecosystem
content.content:
Snaps are the pre-built, configurable building blocks of every SnapLogic pipeline. A Snap represents a single operation: read from a database, transform a field, filter records, write to a file, call an API. Snaps are grouped into **Snap Packs** by technology category (Oracle Snap Pack, Kafka Snap Pack, HTTP Snap Pack, etc.). SnapLogic provides 700+ Snaps across all major enterprise technologies. Custom Snaps can be developed by the customer using the SnapLogic Snap SDK (Java).

- Snaps are fully streaming — data flows through a Snap as a continuous stream, not as a batch loaded into memory
- All Snap execution occurs within the Ground Plex — connector credentials and data never leave AH's network
- Snap Packs are versioned and updated independently of the platform — connector updates do not require platform upgrades
- Snaps are categorised: Read (sources), Transform, Write (targets), Parse, Format, Flow control, Error handling, Script
- Configuration is declarative — no code required for standard operations; expressions used only for custom transformation logic
